## Summary

Describe the public surface changed and why the change is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Python tests pass when Python, CLI, or PFB/PFC behavior changes.
- [ ] C++ tests pass when C++ or PFB/PFC behavior changes.
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation builds pass when documentation changes.
- [ ] `python tools/check_repository.py` passes.
- [ ] Compatibility is preserved or a new format version is proposed.
- [ ] No restricted data, binary, credential, or unrelated change is included.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for user-visible behavior.
